item.skyabyss.stone_whale_call.desc: A hollowed whalebone, for travel. When blown, the stone whale answers from above the clouds
item.skyabyss.stone_whale_call.use: A titan you have met can be called at any time. After the Heart: blow, board, pick a destination (once everyone nearby is aboard, you leave in 5 s). Blow while sneaking to call it for its back instead of for travel (20 min)
item.skyabyss.stone_whale_call.rule: Travel needs the Heart stilled. The back (the dungeon) is entered from the chain of the whale you called down. Day or night, under open sky
message.skyabyss.travel.recognized: Deep in your chest, the whale's song echoes. The titan remembers you now.
message.skyabyss.travel.recognized_hint: You received the Stone Whale Call. It is for riding the titan to another place on the surface, not for entering its back. Blow it under open sky and the whale comes. Touch Titan Waymarks to remember destinations.
message.skyabyss.travel.called: The bone call rises past the clouds. Far away, a low song answers.
message.skyabyss.travel.already_coming: The stone whale is already coming for you.
message.skyabyss.travel.join: The whale is answering %s. Once the chain is down, you can ride along.
message.skyabyss.travel.busy: The whale is with %s now. Your call does not reach it.
message.skyabyss.travel.lifting: Someone is climbing the whale's back chain. You cannot call it now.
message.skyabyss.travel.refuse.not_recog: The call makes no sound. The whale does not know you yet.
message.skyabyss.travel.refuse.wrong_dim: The stone whale does not come to this sky.
message.skyabyss.travel.refuse.indoors: You cannot see the sky. The titan cannot find you here.
message.skyabyss.travel.refuse.underwate: You cannot blow the call underwater.
message.skyabyss.travel.refuse.in_combat: In the middle of a fight, the call does not carry.
message.skyabyss.travel.refuse.riding: You cannot blow the call while riding.
message.skyabyss.travel.refuse.cooldown: The whale is still resting (%s s left).
message.skyabyss.travel.arrived_pickup: The whale lowers its head and lets down a chain. Right-click the chain to be lifted to its head.
message.skyabyss.travel.chain_hint: Right-click the chain to be lifted to the whale's head
message.skyabyss.travel.seated_leader: You sit on the whale's head. Choose a destination on the sky chart. If you close it, blow the call to reopen it.
message.skyabyss.travel.seated: You sit on the whale's head. %s chooses where to go.
message.skyabyss.travel.new_leader: The one who called is gone. You choose where to go.
message.skyabyss.travel.too_close: That is too close. Walking is faster.
message.skyabyss.travel.chosen: Destination: %s. The titan rises in %s seconds. Riders, to the chain. Once everyone is aboard, blow the call to leave at once.
message.skyabyss.travel.boarding: The titan rises in %s s. Riders, to the chain
message.skyabyss.travel.boarding_wait: Waiting for your party to board... %s s
message.skyabyss.travel.all_aboard: Everyone is aboard. Departing in %s s
message.skyabyss.travel.waiting_party: %s of your party are not aboard yet. Once all are on, you leave in 5 s
message.skyabyss.travel.party_call: %1$s has chosen a destination. The chain is about %3$s blocks to the %2$s. Hurry aboard
message.skyabyss.travel.disembark: You are lowered down the chain.
message.skyabyss.travel.no_dismount: Step off here and you fall through the clouds. Wait until you arrive
message.skyabyss.travel.veil: The whale dives into the cloud sea. In the white dark, a long time seems to pass.
message.skyabyss.travel.arrived: The whale sets you down at %s and returns to the sky.
message.skyabyss.travel.aboard_departs: The whale beneath you turns in a great arc. It is swimming somewhere...
message.skyabyss.travel.aboard_arrives: The whale stops swimming. It seems to have reached a new sky. When you leave, it will take you back to where you climbed up.
message.skyabyss.travel.returned_home: The whale circled back to the sky you climbed from before lowering its chain.
message.skyabyss.travel.lost: The whale vanished. The wind catches you and you drift down.
message.skyabyss.travel.woke_landed: When you come to, the whale is gone. It lowered you to the ground.
message.skyabyss.travel.cancel.gone: The caller is gone. The whale returns to the sky.
message.skyabyss.travel.cancel.waited: The whale grew tired of waiting and returned to the sky.
message.skyabyss.travel.cancel.empty: No one is aboard. The whale returns to the sky.
message.skyabyss.travel.cancel.disembark: The whale lets its riders down and returns to the sky.
message.skyabyss.travel.waymark.added: You touch the waymark. "%s" is now a destination (%s / %s).
message.skyabyss.travel.waymark.full: You cannot remember more (up to %s). Forget one on the sky chart.
message.skyabyss.travel.waymark.no_sky: There is no sky above this waymark. Titans cannot see it under a roof.
message.skyabyss.travel.waymark.wrong_di: Titans do not come to this sky.
title.skyabyss.travel.arrive.sub: The whale lets down its chain
gui.skyabyss.travel.title: Sky Chart
item.skyabyss.tide_shell_call.desc: A coral-lipped conch, for travel. Held to the ear, it murmurs with a distant tide
item.skyabyss.tide_shell_call.use: A titan you have met can be called at any time. After the heart: blow, board, pick a destination (once everyone nearby is aboard, you leave in 5 s). Blow while sneaking to call it for its back instead of for travel (20 min)
item.skyabyss.tide_shell_call.rule: Travel needs the heart stilled. The back (the dungeon) is entered through the gate of the shell you called to the shallows. Any tide
message.skyabyss.travel.refuse.no_sea: No sea the tide shell can reach is near. Blow it at the shore.
message.skyabyss.travel.tide_shell.recog: Deep in your chest, a tide came in. That titan remembers you now.

You got the Tide Shell Conch. It is for riding the titan across the sea to another shore, not for entering its back. Blow it at the shore and the tide shell comes into the shallows. For a destination inland, it sets you down on the nearest beach.
message.skyabyss.travel.tide_shell.calle: The conch's note runs over the waves. Out at sea, the tide answers once.
message.skyabyss.travel.tide_shell.refus: The conch stays silent. The tide shell does not know you yet.
The tide shell does not come to the seas of this land.
You cannot see the sky. The tide shell cannot find you here.
You cannot blow the conch underwater.
In the middle of a fight, the conch's note does not carry.
You cannot blow the conch while riding something.
The titans are still resting (%s s left).
message.skyabyss.travel.tide_shell.arriv: The tide shell has come into the shallows and lifted the rim of its shell above the water. Step into the column of bubbles at the water's edge and the tide carries you up onto the shell.
message.skyabyss.travel.tide_shell.chain: Step into the bubble column at the water's edge to be carried up onto the tide shell
message.skyabyss.travel.tide_shell.seate: You sit on the crown of the tide shell. Choose a destination on the tide chart. If you close it, blow the conch to open it again.
You sit on the crown of the tide shell. %s chooses where to go.
message.skyabyss.travel.tide_shell.disem: The tide carries you back to the water's edge.
message.skyabyss.travel.tide_shell.no_di: Get off here and you fall into the open sea. Wait until the beach
message.skyabyss.travel.tide_shell.under: About %2$s s to the beach near %1$s
message.skyabyss.travel.tide_shell.veil: The tide shell sinks into a deep current. In the blue dark, you hear a far sea singing.
message.skyabyss.travel.tide_shell.arriv: The tide shell sets you down on a beach near %s and walks back out to sea.
message.skyabyss.travel.tide_shell.cance: Nobody who called is here. The tide shell went back out to sea.
Tired of waiting, the tide shell went back out to sea.
Nobody is on the shell. The tide shell went back out to sea.
The tide shell returned its riders to the water's edge and went back out to sea.
message.skyabyss.travel.tide_shell.lost: The tide shell vanished among the waves. The tide catches you and lets you sink slowly.
message.skyabyss.travel.tide_shell.busy: The tide shell is with %s now. Your conch does not reach it.
message.skyabyss.travel.tide_shell.join: The tide shell is answering %s. Once the bubble column rises, you can ride along.
message.skyabyss.travel.tide_shell.alrea: The tide shell is already on its way to you.
message.skyabyss.travel.tide_shell.no_se: There is no sea the tide shell can walk near that destination.
item.skyabyss.thunder_wing_call.desc: A flight feather with lightning running down its vane. Held high, a far-off storm turns toward you
item.skyabyss.thunder_wing_call.use: Raise it: the thunder wing lands on a high peak nearby and raises its updraft. For 20 minutes, you can board its back
item.skyabyss.thunder_wing_call.rule: Only those who have met the thunder wing can use it. Works outside the storm hours, under open sky. It does not answer while it sleeps
item.skyabyss.ember_call.desc: A small bell caked in ash. When rung, something deep underfoot stirs
item.skyabyss.ember_call.use: Ring it: the ember rises on the nearest land and opens and closes its mouth. For 20 minutes, you can board its back when the mouth is open
item.skyabyss.ember_call.rule: Only those who have met the ember can use it. Works by day as well as by night. It does not answer while it sleeps
message.skyabyss.titan_call.not_met: %s does not know you yet. Go and meet it first
message.skyabyss.titan_call.no_sky: No sky in sight. %s cannot find you here
message.skyabyss.titan_call.absent: %s has not shown itself in this world yet
message.skyabyss.titan_call.here: %s is right here. You can board its back
message.skyabyss.titan_call.sleeping: %s is asleep. About %s minutes until it wakes
message.skyabyss.titan_call.met_hint: Your call can be used from the pouch. A titan you have met will come near whenever you call, and lend its back for 20 minutes
message.skyabyss.titan_call.met.stone_wh: The stone whale's song echoed deep in your chest. With this whistle, you can call it any time
message.skyabyss.titan_call.met.tide_she: The murmur of the tide stays in your ear. With this conch, you can call it any time
message.skyabyss.titan_call.met.thunder_: A single flight feather drifted down out of the storm. With it, you can call the thunder wing
message.skyabyss.titan_call.met.ember: The heat underfoot has set into the shape of a small bell. With it, you can call the ember
message.skyabyss.titan_call.called.stone: The bone whistle sounds. Far away, a low song answers
message.skyabyss.titan_call.called.tide_: The conch's note melts into the tide. Beyond the shallows, something stirs
message.skyabyss.titan_call.called.thund: The feather cuts the wind. Far-off thunder turns toward you
message.skyabyss.titan_call.called.ember: The bell rings in the ash. The deep ground begins to lift, slowly
message.skyabyss.titan_call.no_place.sto: There is nowhere to descend. Try a more open spot
message.skyabyss.titan_call.no_place.tid: There are no shallows nearby to come to. Call at the shore
message.skyabyss.titan_call.no_place.thu: No peak nearby to land on. Try an open place where the ground shows
message.skyabyss.titan_call.no_place.emb: No flat land nearby to lie on. Try a more open stretch of ground
